headline: Cyberattack on South Korea postal service exposes personal data of over 113000 people
label: NEWS
caption:
A major cyberattack hits postal systems overseas 🚨

According to TRT World, a cyberattack on South Korea's postal service has exposed the personal data of over 113000 people.

Authorities are currently investigating the security breach to determine the extent of the compromised information.

What security measures should governments take to protect citizen data online? 👇
